topic.title: Where is the SDK mentioned in the competition description?

messages.content:
Hi all,
The competition overview mentions that participants will be provided with an SDK/toolkit for local development, but I'm a little confused about what exactly that refers to.
After looking through the sample notebooks, I found the cg-lib dataset, which contains the cg package (api.py, game.py, sim.py, utils.py) along with the platform-specific libraries (libcg.so, libcg.dylib, etc.).
Is cg-lib the SDK referred to in the competition description, or is there another SDK/toolkit that I'm missing?
If cg-lib is the intended SDK, it might be helpful to add a link to it from the competition overview or Data page, as it wasn't immediately obvious where the SDK was located.
Thanks!
